source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle, after an enemy unit finishes a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) up to 8" from this model, the model can set off its Reductus mine: roll a D6, and on a 2+ the enemy unit takes D3+3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds). In each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/the-battle-round), only a single model of yours with this ability can do so.

**Designer's Note**: keep a Reductus Mine token beside the model until this ability is used.

detail.designerNote: track with a Reductus Mine token
